inputs.description: Illustrative commercial product procurement, support and subscription avoidance; no outsourced development or replacement-build budgets; not audited net savings.
inputs.baseline_source: Amounts carried from the prior CV; treated as provisional estimates, not independently verified vendor quotations.

sources.label: GitHub Team pricing
sources.basis: USD 4 per user/month benchmark; introductory and renewal terms may differ. Frozen for this scenario, not asserted as six years of actual invoicing.

sources.label: PositiveSSL DV wildcard pricing
sources.basis: USD 270 listed annual DV wildcard price. One group in the central scenario; 100 websites are not treated as 200 separately paid certificates.

sources.label: OpenText public software and maintenance price list
sources.basis: Some Documentum maintenance lines list first-year maintenance at 23% of licence. Context only, not an EIL quote. This model instead assumes 10% on half the provisional baseline.

sources.label: Let's Encrypt service
sources.basis: Certificate issuance and automated renewal are available without certificate licence charges. Hosting and operations still have costs.

sources.label: GitLab paid and free plans
sources.basis: Free self-managed plan and USD 29 Premium seats exist. Premium pricing is excluded from the central estimate; GitHub and GitLab licences are alternatives, not additive savings.

sources.label: Oracle Aconex product scope
sources.basis: Engineering document/review and supplier collaboration product. Used to establish product-category fit only, not an extra price or full feature-equivalence claim.

sources.label: SafetyCulture inspection platform
sources.basis: Candidate for inspection workflows only. No current price assumed or added.

sources.label: Metabase product pricing
sources.basis: Pro USD 6,210/year plus USD 130/user/year beyond the first 10; free self-hosted option also listed. No AI procurement saving added.

sources.label: Novu product pricing
sources.basis: Cloud Pro from USD 30/month; Free has 10,000 workflow runs/month; enterprise self-hosted options require a quote. No notification procurement saving added.

sources.label: FileHold perpetual software and support catalogue
sources.basis: Page 4 MSRP: perpetual five-user/server bundle USD 10,900; two-user additions USD 1,500 each. Annual FileCare: USD 2,100 base plus USD 400 per two-user addition. Bundle has five concurrent sessions. Public US reseller benchmark; no Texas discount assumed.

sources.label: FileHold perpetual purchase model
sources.basis: Vendor explains outright perpetual licensing separately from annual support and subscription licensing.

sources.label: FileHold licensing terms
sources.basis: Distinguishes cloud, self-hosted subscription and perpetual agreements; use the perpetual alternative here.

sources.label: FileHold registered and concurrent licensing
sources.basis: Registered-user capacity and concurrent access are different licence dimensions. The CEIL benchmark does not imply 50 simultaneous sessions.

ceil_product.licensing_model: One-time perpetual licence purchase; annual FileCare support separately priced
ceil_product.user_count_status: 50 registered users is an illustrative requirement, not a reported CEIL count. Round two-user packs up; 50 requires capacity for 51. The base includes only five concurrent sessions; additional concurrency is unpriced.
ceil_product.purchase_basis: Owner confirms CEIL-eDMS replaced procurement of a separately deployed on-premise DMS.
ceil_product.fit: General commercial on-premise DMS with document workflows and permissions; engineering review, external access, concurrency and integration equivalence require a scoped quote.
ceil_product.scope: One licence purchase plus INR 5 lakh assumed product installation/configuration allowance and one year of separately priced support. No cloud or self-hosted software subscription, extra server licence, or six-year CEIL AMC assumption.
ceil_product.price_basis: MSRP columns in the public CBM Archives DIR-CPO-5831 catalogue, not its Texas purchaser discount. Public US benchmark, not an Indian tender or CEIL quote. Product installation/configuration allowance is an assumption; bespoke application development is excluded.

excluded_comparisons.price_basis: Quote required for applicable deployment and commercial terms. Document review, supplier collaboration and transmittals are a relevant product category.
excluded_comparisons.reason: May overlap the existing DMS/client portal baseline or one shared product licence. No separate amount added.

excluded_comparisons.price_basis: No procurement amount assumed. Low-code platform prices are not a finished employee-services/PWA/native app product.
excluded_comparisons.reason: Custom product delivery remains an achievement; no avoided product purchase established.

excluded_comparisons.price_basis: Inspection-product candidate; buyer requirements, paid users and applicable plan not established.
excluded_comparisons.reason: A partial mobile use case, not a substitute for the whole enterprise app. Excluded pending a credible purchase scope.

excluded_comparisons.price_basis: Pro listed at USD 6,210/year plus USD 130/year per user beyond 10; free self-hosted option exists.
excluded_comparisons.reason: Partial analytics/SQL alternative; Oracle/local-model fit and a paid procurement need are not established. Excluded.

excluded_comparisons.price_basis: Cloud Pro starts at USD 30/month; Free supports 10,000 workflow runs/month. Enterprise self-hosting is quote-based.
excluded_comparisons.reason: Paid tier, traffic and deployment requirements are unknown. Excluded; no hypothetical paid purchase assumed.

result.headline: Approximately INR 10.5 crore
result.status: Illustrative product-cost scenario, not audited net savings or a historical total
